scene: spire with core config.core.duelPreset and its Duel nav graph (vectors/navGraph.json graphs[0]; equal to the Unity repo's PortExport/maps/spire.json duelNavGraph)
order: per step: place the target; set hp; onPlayerFire if scheduled; fresh createInputFrame(); brain.step(frame, dt); record frame / look / state / visible; mover.step(frame, dt); arena.checkPads(mover); record pos / mstate
recordNote: {i, target: {p, v}, hp, playerFire: null | {origin, dir}, frame: {moveX, moveZ, yaw, pitch, jump, dash, slide, fire: {pressed, held}, weapon}, look: {yaw, pitch} (after brain.step), state, visible, draws (rng draws so far, after brain.step), pos (the bot mover after its step + checkPads), mstate (its MoveState)}
